The dataset has no counterfactual outcomes, so I estimated the average treatment effect on the control (ATC) with an outcome-regression (imputation) approach. I fit OLS of the outcome on all 25 covariates using only the treated units. I then predicted the treated outcome for each control unit and averaged the difference (predicted minus observed) over the controls. This gives an ATC of about 3.88.

A single OLS with treatment plus all covariates gives a similar effect of 3.83, so the estimate is not sensitive to the method.

ANSWER: 3.88
